title: Open X Embodiment Robotic Learning Datasets and RT X Models
claims: **Generalizable Robot Policies**: We propose a high-capacity model (RT-X) trained on this data that can be adapted to new robots, tasks, and environments.
**Diverse Data Coverage**: The dataset includes 527 skills across 160,266 tasks from 22 different robotic platforms.
